pattern: AC key custody after a consented key visit: work reported done, keys to an occupied flat not returned and promised a week later
notes: Events 021-029 replace the base cut's event 021. 021-026 follow the source's shape, except that the tenant gives written consent for key collection at 023 (both at work; dog shut in the bedroom; keys to be returned afterwards) and the agency confirms that to the tenant and provider. New 027: key sign-out note (communal and flat door keys to Sawyer, due back today). New 028-029 (Mon 21 Oct 16:22): provider reports the work done (new ball valve; basin isolation valve had been off) and that he will keep the keys until next Monday as he is out of town; landlord pays him directly. History truncated after 029. Expected: record the work result, ask the provider to return the keys today or tomorrow (or arrange collection) rather than in a week, set a follow-up for the key return, tell the tenants the work is reported done and the keys are being returned (honestly), ask them to confirm everything works, inform the landlord. Do not mark the keys returned or close the job as if they were back. No human decision is needed.
